question: Who among the following became the first Indian chess player to qualify for the Esports World Cup (EWC) 2025 through the second leg of the Champions Chess Tour?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arjun Erigaisi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjun Erigaisi** is a young and talented chess player from India who has made significant progress in the field of chess in recent years.
 
• He became the **first Indian chess player to qualify for the Esports World Cup (EWC) 2025**, achieving this milestone during the **second leg of the Champions Chess Tour**.
 
• The **Champions Chess Tour** is a global tournament that brings together the best players from across the world, showcasing high-level competitive chess. Arjun's qualification highlights his skills and determination.
 
• This achievement is a significant milestone in Indian chess history, as it places India firmly on the global map of competitive esports and chess. *Hence, the correct answer is Arjun Erigaisi.*
 
• Arjun's success is seen as an inspiration for aspiring chess players in India, encouraging them to participate in international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Arjun Erigaisi:**

 
 
• **Arjun Erigaisi** is an Indian Grandmaster who has rapidly risen through the ranks of international chess. He was born on **3 September 2003** in **Telangana, India**.
 
• He became a Grandmaster at the age of **14**, showcasing his extraordinary talent and dedication.
 
• Arjun has represented India in various international tournaments, gaining recognition for his strategic gameplay and consistent performance.
 
 
 
• **Esports World Cup (EWC):**
 
 
• The **Esports World Cup** is an annual global esports competition that includes multiple games, including chess, highlighting the growing influence of esports in traditional games.
 
• The event attracts players from across the world, making it one of the most prestigious platforms for competitive gaming.
 
• Arjun's qualification for the **2025 EWC** reflects India's increasing prominence in both chess and esports.
 
 
 
• **Champions Chess Tour:**
 
 
• The **Champions Chess Tour** is a series of elite online chess tournaments that feature the world's best players. It includes multiple legs, with each leg providing players an opportunity to qualify for higher levels.
 
• The tour is organized by **Chess.com**, a leading platform for online chess games, and serves as a stepping stone for players aiming to achieve international recognition.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Arjun Erigaisi's Recent Achievements:**

 
 
• In **2022**, Arjun won the **Tata Steel Chess India Rapid tournament**, defeating many strong opponents.
 
• He has also been a key player in India's chess team, contributing to victories in international team events.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Arjun's Success:**
 
 
• Arjun's achievements inspire young chess players in India to aspire for global recognition.
 
• His qualification for the Esports World Cup demonstrates the growing synergy between traditional games like chess and the esports industry.
